content.comment_body: I installed a [product_name] with an RTD module to manage temperature in two brewery hot water tanks, using RTDs and the controller for electric heating. The setup operated well for several months but recently started experiencing random signal dropouts. When isolating either tank, each works independently. My troubleshooting so far has included: verifying RTD wiring and connections, replacing RTDs, checking all grounding and bonding, ensuring the RTD shield is only grounded at one end, swapping out the RTD module, separating RTDs onto individual modules, and confirming a steady 24V supply. Despite these efforts, the issue persists. Does anyone have suggestions?
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Regarding your setup, where have you grounded the shield—at the tank or at the RTD module?

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports instability with a temperature control system based on [product_name] and RTD modules in a brewery. After months of reliable operation, the system now experiences random RTD signal losses. The user has performed extensive troubleshooting, including verifying wiring, grounding, module replacements, and power supply checks, yet the intermittent problem remains when multiple RTDs are connected.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks consistent and uninterrupted performance from the [product_name] system when using several RTD inputs, aiming to eliminate random signal dropouts observed after initial successful use.
